Figure 1:Three dimensions of GUI environment construction.Top: reward coverage. A verifier rewards long-press
deletion but not an edit-sheet solution that reaches the same goal.
Middle: data coverage. R0/R1/R2 retain the records the task needs
and vary the unrelated ones. Bottom: feature coverage. Full/F0/F1
expose different application functions. Policies train in the reduced
environments and are evaluated in Full.

Figure 3:Episode weighting changes the environment effect.Left: response averaging gives longer episodes more advantage-bearing terms, and episode balancing removes this dependence with weightsC/TiC/T_{i}.
Right: four continuations start from the same F0 step 12 model. Counts show successes
on 153 retention instances evaluated in Full. Weighting reverses the F0–Full
gap, yielding an 18.30-point interaction.

Figure 4:Selective functional pruning in MobileGym-Lite.Full-screen screenshots use identical task states. Clock retains four tabs
in Full, one in F0, and two in Lite. WeChat retains the profile card:
F0 disables clicking and removes its chevron, and Lite restores both.
Moments is removed in F0 and Lite. Circles highlight these controls, and dashed circles mark missing WeChat entrances.
